page.content:
Americas, Australia, South Africa, and other regions that often lead with variety.

How New World wine connects

  • Topic: Wine — New World wine is the varietal-led tradition of the Americas and Antipodes.
  • Location: Napa Valley — Napa Valley is the United States' flagship New World fine-wine region.
  • Location: Barossa Valley — Barossa Valley is a New World Shiraz landmark in Australia.
  • Location: Mendoza — Mendoza is Argentina's New World Malbec capital.

What is New World wine?

New World wine is the counterpart branding: Napa Cabernet, Barossa Shiraz, Mendoza Malbec — sunshine, varietal labels, and a conversation with Old World benchmarks.

Key threads lead to Wine, Napa Valley, Barossa Valley and Mendoza.
